+CAMERAS = ("head_camera", "front_camera", "left_camera", "right_camera", "observer_camera")
+OUT = "/app/output/trajectory"
+os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)
+r = Robot()
+
+
+def move(left_xyz=None, right_xyz=None, left_gripper=None, right_gripper=None,
+         right_dz=0.0, right_z=None, note=""):
+    obs = r.get_obs(video="none")
+    p = np.asarray(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=np.float32)
+
+    left = p[14:21].copy()
+    right = p[21:28].copy()
+    if left_xyz is not None:
+        left[:3] = left_xyz
+    if right_xyz is not None:
+        right[:3] = right_xyz
+    right[2] += right_dz
+    if right_z is not None:
+        right[2] = right_z
+
+    lg = float(p[28] if left_gripper is None else left_gripper)
+    rg = float(p[29] if right_gripper is None else right_gripper)
+    action = np.r_[left, lg, right, rg].astype(np.float32)[None, :]
+    result = r.submit("ee_pose", action, video="both", video_fps=8,
+                      cameras=CAMERAS, note=note)
+    index = len(os.listdir(OUT))
+    result.save(os.path.join(OUT, f"{index:02d}_{note or 'move'}"))
+    if result.meta.get("done"):
+        raise RuntimeError(f"episode ended: {result.meta.get('reason')}")
+    plan = result.meta.get("plan", [])
+    if plan and any(v != "Success" for k, v in plan[0].items() if k in ("left", "right")):
+        raise RuntimeError(f"motion plan failed: {plan}")
+    return result
+
+
+# Stage above the fan, then approach and grip its lower stand from the front.
+move(left_xyz=(-0.065, -0.105, 1.10), right_xyz=(0.065, -0.105, 1.10),
+     left_gripper=1.0, right_gripper=1.0, note="hover")
+move(right_xyz=(-0.030, -0.280, 0.840), right_gripper=1.0, note="pregrasp")
+move(right_xyz=(-0.030, -0.230, 0.800), right_gripper=1.0, note="approach")
+move(right_gripper=0.0, note="grip")
+move(right_dz=0.035, right_gripper=0.0, note="grip_check")
+move(right_z=0.950, right_gripper=0.0, note="lift_clear")
+
+# The measured table-frame shift centers the fan base on the red mat. The yaw
+# is held fixed throughout, preserving the fan's robot-facing direction.
+move(right_xyz=(-0.170, -0.270, 0.950), right_gripper=0.0, note="carry")
+move(right_xyz=(-0.170, -0.270, 0.800), right_gripper=0.0, note="lower")
+move(right_gripper=1.0, note="release")
+move(right_xyz=(-0.170, -0.380, 0.960), right_gripper=1.0, note="retract")
+
+settled = r.get_obs(cameras=CAMERAS, seconds=1.0, video="both", video_fps=5)
+settled.save(os.path.join(OUT, "settled"))
+print({"done": settled.meta.get("done"), "reason": settled.meta.get("reason"),
+       "time_left_s": settled.meta.get("time_left_s")})
*** End Patch";
text(await tools.apply_patch(patch));
